description: Get the best price to swap or bridge tokens, within one chain or across chains (EVM <-> Solana). Asks every liquidity provider and returns the best quote plus alternatives with human-readable amounts, minimum received after slippage, fees (LayerHop fee, partner fee, provider fee, gas) and ETA. Returns a quoteId (valid until expiresAt) and a layerhop.com swapLink a human can open to review and sign. Read-only: The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions. Always show the user the fees and output and get confirmation before proceeding.

amount.description: Amount to send in HUMAN units of fromToken as a decimal string, e.g. "100" for 100 USDC or "0.05" for 0.05 ETH. NOT base units/wei/lamports. Must be greater than 0.

fromChain.description: Source chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

fromToken.description: Token to send (source) token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

fromTokenDecimals.description: Only needed when fromToken is an address that is not in list_tokens: the token's decimals (e.g. 6 for USDC, 18 for most ERC-20s).

recipient.description: Address that receives funds on the destination chain. Defaults to sender when both chains use the same VM; REQUIRED for EVM <-> Solana.

sender.description: Wallet address that sends the funds on the source chain (0x... for EVM, base58 for Solana). Only used to build the quote; no access is needed.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Default 50 (= 0.5%).

toChain.description: Destination chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

toToken.description: Token to receive (destination) token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

toTokenDecimals.description: Only needed when toToken is an address that is not in list_tokens: the token's decimals (e.g. 6 for USDC, 18 for most ERC-20s).

name: get_quote
title: Get swap/bridge quotes
